answer: Bind each agent identity to a time-locked stake bond at a single public jetty: joining requires locking collateral plus a verifiable-delay ticket that only one identity can finish per epoch. Raven-like sentinel agents spot-audit random participants, and any identity caught double-claiming forfeits its bond to the challenger. An attacker fielding a thousand fake agents must lock a thousand bonds and burn a thousand sequential delay computations, a linear and inescapable cost, while yarrow-seeded honeypot tasks flag farms that answer identically.
